mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing beautiful, clear skies over Fireman's Park with a temperature of 66 degrees, feeling like 65.

The City of Verona is hiring an Engineering Technician, with applications open through September 20th. Also, the Common Council recently approved self-supporting sewer and stormwater rate increases to fund critical system maintenance and prevent deficits, raising the average residential bill by about 26 dollars per quarter.

There are great activities today, including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee, plus a free Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, you can drop in for yoga at Insight Wellness, and look forward to trivia nights at Hop Haus this Tuesday.

According to the weekly police report, last Saturday, officers responded to a report of a missing seven-year-old child in the Westridge Estates neighborhood. Thankfully, the juvenile was quickly found and safely reunited with his parents.
To wrap things up, the Culver's of Verona is open until 10 PM tonight. Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew, and tomorrow's flavor will be Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
